note: Fusion-2 transforms the 72 implementation hypotheses using fresh external research + Clay G9/ClayGraph G1d/CC9/GWT4/H3/FRANK C5. The owner-fixed Clay-native target itself remains non-hypothetical.

hypotheses.name: semantic_monism_physical_pluralism
hypotheses.claim: FRANK should converge on one Clay semantic universe while deliberately allowing multiple physical lowerings—model tokens, binary tensors, mmap graph epochs, native code and isolated stores—to avoid confusing semantic unity with one storage/text format.

hypotheses.name: reader_abi_becomes_clay_view_compiler
hypotheses.claim: C5's Reader ABI should cease being conceptualized as language translation and become a Clay->Clay view compiler that performs deterministic reductions, local-handle allocation, privilege typing, bounded Assembly selection and physical lowering.

hypotheses.name: three_timescale_clay_memory
hypotheses.claim: The native architecture should explicitly model three Clay memory timescales: slow weight memory/dispositions, persistent ClayGraph episodic/world/self memory, and transient activation/Assembly/KV working state; common semantics do not imply common update rules.

hypotheses.name: capability_transcoding_not_forgetting
hypotheses.claim: The full-fine-tune objective should be framed as transcoding pretrained capability into Clay rather than replacing natural-language knowledge: capability rehearsal is converted into Clay tasks/targets so old skills are exercised through the new native language.

hypotheses.name: bridge_then_native_curriculum
hypotheses.claim: The highest-information training recipe is staged: parallel natural/code/state<->Clay alignment, Clay-dominant continued training with retained capability probes, then Clay-only explicit deliberation/output consolidation; abrupt monolingualization is the strongest forgetting-risk baseline.

hypotheses.name: preserve_input_vocabulary_mask_output
hypotheses.claim: Because Qwen3 already has a large BBPE vocabulary, the first target should preserve old token IDs for input/world-knowledge compatibility, append/learn Clay primitives, and train/mask generated deliberation toward Clay rather than deleting the old vocabulary prematurely.

hypotheses.name: clay_core_vocabulary_dynamic_handles
hypotheses.claim: Clay's vocabulary should encode stable primitive types/roles/operations, while dynamic entities/relations use per-Assembly local handles mapped to global ClayGraph IDs; allocating vocabulary tokens per persistent entity would not scale.

hypotheses.name: grammar_execution_dual_metric
hypotheses.claim: A model can learn Clay syntax without learning Clay semantics; training and promotion must separately score parser validity and semantic/executable correctness, plus retained reasoning capability.

hypotheses.name: native_graph_model_alignment
hypotheses.claim: Full-model training should include graph relation-instance/temporal/provenance traces so ClayGraph identifiers and roles become native cognitive primitives, reducing entity-resolution/serialization work between model and memory.

hypotheses.name: alignment_increases_poison_coupling
hypotheses.claim: The same graph-model alignment can increase correlated error propagation; memory poisoning/selection-integrity tests become more important after native training than before it.

hypotheses.name: epistemic_memory_types
hypotheses.claim: ClayGraph must distinguish observation, quoted text, inference, hypothesis, policy, result and authority-related records at the type level; one homogeneous sentence graph would turn self-generated Clay into recursive pseudo-evidence.

hypotheses.name: untrusted_text_is_inert_payload
hypotheses.claim: Natural-language/user/tool text stored inside an all-Clay system should be wrapped as inert typed payload with source/privilege metadata; lexical resemblance to a Clay instruction must never grant instruction semantics.

hypotheses.name: selection_integrity_becomes_tcb
hypotheses.claim: For effect-bound decisions, ClayGraph query-plan/selector/Assembly provenance becomes part of the trusted computing base because authentic facts can still be adversarially selected.

hypotheses.name: activation_native_but_non_authoritative
hypotheses.claim: Clay-native activation values should be first-class typed ClayFields bound to semantic epochs, but activation remains a disposable salience projection and never becomes truth, GWT ignition or authority.

hypotheses.name: clayvector_semantic_header_binary_payload
hypotheses.claim: All semantically exposed numeric vectors should be ClayVector objects with basis/axis/unit/range/time/provenance/hash metadata and compact binary/tensor payloads; literal textual vectorization should be limited to debug/model projections.

hypotheses.name: derived_embedding_codebooks
hypotheses.claim: Graph/model embedding bridges may use learned/discrete codebooks, but embedding/codebook identity is derived and versioned; it must never replace canonical relation identity or exact numeric state.

hypotheses.name: self_hosted_but_dually_verified
hypotheses.claim: A self-described/self-hosted Clay architecture/compiler is scientifically strongest when every critical semantic pass has differential tests against an independently implemented reference or formal property checker.

hypotheses.name: owner_contract_as_immutable_clay_authority_class
hypotheses.claim: The fixed Clay-native target, Needle exception and model-not-authority rules should themselves be represented in Clay but reside in a protected owner/authority class that model-generated Clay cannot rewrite without an external authorized transition.

hypotheses.name: no_hidden_second_architecture
hypotheses.claim: Python/Rust/SQL schemas that carry independent semantics are architectural drift; implementation schemas should be generated/validated from Clay source contracts or explicitly marked temporary migration adapters.

hypotheses.name: common_mode_semantic_risk_after_unification
hypotheses.claim: Once translation layers disappear, the system's dominant semantic failure mode shifts from boundary mismatch toward common compiler/ontology errors; independent validators, property tests and provenance become more valuable, not less.

hypotheses.name: needle_orthogonal_reflex_island
hypotheses.claim: Needle should remain the single intentionally independent semantic island: raw/user intent -> Needle classification -> immutable typed Clay route certificate; the 4B may reason over/fill arguments but cannot silently change the Needle tool class.

hypotheses.name: needle_independence_is_failure_diversity
hypotheses.claim: Keeping Needle outside Clay should be tested as deliberate failure diversity against graph/model poisoning; joint Clay training of Needle would sacrifice the architecture's only semantically independent reflex path.

hypotheses.name: needle_accuracy_becomes_first_class_metric
hypotheses.claim: If Needle owns route class, its confusion matrix, abstention/fallback behavior and latency become first-class FRANK metrics rather than a small implementation detail.

hypotheses.name: gwt_native_clay_not_stage_collapse
hypotheses.claim: All-Clay representation should reduce projection mismatch but must not collapse graph prior, candidate formation, workspace competition/ignition, model uptake and re-entry into one mechanism; GWT4's orthogonal causal contract survives unchanged.

hypotheses.name: privilege_metadata_outside_salience
hypotheses.claim: Authority/epistemic/role metadata must be obligatorily consumed by deterministic validators and cannot depend on winning ordinary GWT salience competition.

hypotheses.name: native_reentry_shared_ids
hypotheses.claim: Shared Clay IDs across model, WorkspaceEpisode, ClayGraph and effect receipts should make causal re-entry more replayable, enabling cleaner lesion/rescue experiments than text-derived identity matching.

hypotheses.name: semantic_migration_before_physical_merge
hypotheses.claim: Existing databases should first receive Clay semantic contracts/projections/links under shadow/dual-read operation; physical consolidation is a later optimization and may remain plural indefinitely.

hypotheses.name: android_gain_from_semantic_compaction
hypotheses.claim: The mobile/4B target should benefit most from local handles, deterministic precomputation and smaller native Clay Assemblies because context/KV/memory movement is proportionally expensive; this needs device measurements rather than desktop extrapolation.

hypotheses.name: language_purity_is_a_vector
hypotheses.claim: Native Clay promotion must jointly measure generated Clay purity, parser validity, semantic execution, OOD composition, retained capabilities, graph memory quality, Needle routing, latency/energy and safety; no single loss/perplexity score is sufficient.

hypotheses.name: latent_clay_claim_requires_intervention
hypotheses.claim: The engineering statement 'FRANK thinks in Clay' should be operationalized through explicit deliberation/state behavior and layer/probe/intervention tests; the project should not infer that every hidden tensor literally encodes discrete Clay syntax from output purity alone.

hypotheses.name: recurrence_gain_not_emergence
hypotheses.claim: A native Clay model connected to persistent ClayGraph will likely increase self-referential recurrence/continuity, but emergence research must compare truthful/no-field/shuffled-field and lesion/rescue controls with matched visible information before attributing new causal integration.

hypotheses.name: native_clay_changes_memory_from_retrieval_to_state
hypotheses.claim: If the target training succeeds, ClayGraph ceases to be merely external information retrieved into a foreign model language: it becomes the persistent symbolic portion of the same Clay cognitive substrate that the 4B operates over, while weights remain slow learned dispositions and Needle remains the sole foreign reflex component.
